svg.title: Initial waiting is only part of a multi-iteration response

svg.text: Initial waiting is only part of a multi-iteration response
Constructed single server clock • milliseconds • no runtime measurements
Name first service and first output
Arrival 0; admission 2; preprocessing 5
First model start 10; first ID commit 32
TTFT 32; model-start timer hides 10
Partition adjacent phases once
58 = 2 admission + 16 wait + 40 phase
Ready waits 3 + 2 + 7 + 4 = 16 ms
Phase elapsed is not exclusive GPU time
Waiting recurs after the first token
ID commits 32,45,55; gaps 13,10 ms
First gap = 1 prep + 7 wait + 4 work
+ 1 commit = 13 ms
Completion has more than one endpoint
Last selected ID 55; logical terminal 58
Final host/output reader releases at 60
Nested spans cannot be summed blindly
Processing and waiting labels apply to this declared phase partition.
Use compatible clocks and current request/attempt/step/generation identity.
